Title: Analytics
Subtitle: Anonymous, sampled operation totals for MyDevTools.
AuthMessage: Your Cloudflare Access session is missing or has expired. Sign in again to view the report.
ConfigMessage: The private reporting service is unavailable because its server-side configuration is incomplete.
UpstreamMessage: The analytics service could not produce a report. Try again shortly.
NetworkMessage: The report could not be reached. Check your connection and try again.

ActivityDescription: Daily started, completed, failed and explicitly cancelled operation totals.
EstimateNote: Totals are weighted estimates because sampled rows represent up to {interval} operations.
RetentionNote: Rolling detail comes from the available analytics window; monthly aggregate snapshots are retained by calendar year. Boundary days can be partial UTC days.
PrivacyNote: These are anonymous operation counts, not unique people. Started and terminal events are independent and do not form an exact conversion rate. New coverage and our own QA runs can affect small-sample rankings.
ChartLabel: Operation activity over the selected period
Comparison90Note: A previous 90-day baseline is unavailable within rolling-detail retention.
DistributionDescription: Successful processing duration buckets and privacy-safe failure categories. Unknown historical dimensions remain explicitly unclassified.
VotesDescription: Totals for fixed suggestions; votes count selections, not unique people or commitments.
HistoryDescription: Choose any available calendar year. The current UTC month is provisional.
HistoryEmpty: No archived months are available for this year.
